overview.title: Dashboard
overview.description: How your organization is doing right now.

noScope.title: No workspace selected
noScope.description: Choose an organization or academy to see its dashboard.

error.title: Couldn't load your dashboard
error.description: Something went wrong fetching your latest numbers. Try again in a moment.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Earnings recorded by Atlas from course sales.

notTracked.title: Not tracked here
notTracked.ownGateway: Your academy collects payments through your own gateway, so this money never passes through Atlas and we have no figure to show. Check your gateway's own dashboard for earnings.
notTracked.unconfigured: Set up how you collect payments to start seeing earnings here.

none.title: No earnings yet
none.description: Once your first course sale goes through, it will appear here.

usage.title: Plan usage
usage.description: What you're using against your current plan.

unavailable.title: Usage isn't available yet
unavailable.description: Your plan usage appears here once your subscription is active and the first figures have been calculated.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.description: The latest changes across your workspace.

empty.title: Nothing has happened yet
empty.description: Changes to courses, lessons and your team will show up here as they happen.

form.title: Need a hand?
form.description: Tell us what's going on and our team will pick it up.
form.subjectPlaceholder: A short summary of the problem
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the problem, and what you were doing when it came up.
form.success: Thanks — your ticket is in. We'll be in touch by email.

errors.subjectRequired: Add a subject so we know what this is about.
errors.descriptionRequired: Tell us what's happening so we can help.
errors.submitFailed: We couldn't send your ticket. Please try again in a moment.

list.title: Your tickets
list.description: Tickets you've submitted, and where they stand.
list.loadFailed: We couldn't load your tickets. Please try again in a moment.

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.description: Anything you submit will show up here so you can follow its progress.

studentAnalytics.title: Student analytics
studentAnalytics.description: How your students are progressing, based on real enrolment and progress data.

error.title: Couldn't load student analytics
error.description: Something went wrong fetching your analytics. Please try again.

funnel.title: Completion funnel
funnel.description: Enrolled students who have started, and who have finished.

empty.title: No enrolments yet
empty.description: Once students enrol in a course, their progress through it appears here.

trends.title: Cohort trends
trends.description: New enrolments and completions per month.

atRisk.title: Students who may need help
atRisk.description: Students on a course they haven't finished, flagged after {{days}} days without progress or after not passing a quiz.

empty.title: No students flagged
empty.description: Nobody currently meets the at-risk criteria. That's a good sign.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Quiz integrity events, lesson-access sharing signals and plan usage for this academy.

error.title: Couldn't load this report
error.description: Something went wrong fetching the report. Please try again.

forbidden.title: You can't view reports for this academy
forbidden.description: Reports are available to the academy's owner, admins and managers. Ask an owner if you need access.

reports.truncated: Some lists were shortened to their top entries. The headline figures are complete.

integrity.title: Integrity summary
integrity.description: Events recorded during monitored quiz attempts — tab switches, focus loss, fullscreen exits, copy, paste and printing.

empty.title: No integrity events
empty.description: No events were recorded during quiz attempts in this window.

sharing.title: Sharing signals
sharing.description: Lesson-access grants and refusals. Repeated refusals for one learner point to a shared account or too many devices.

empty.title: No access activity
empty.description: No lesson-access grants or refusals were recorded in this window.

quota.title: Plan usage
quota.description: Your organization's usage against its current plan limits. Limits are enforced by the server, not by this page.
